descriptions.zh:
我们已经失去了生育能力。母星上到处都是废弃的教育中心，游乐场空无一人。我们因衰老而消亡几乎只是时间问题。现在，我们只能寄希望于我们人格仓库里的数据库存了。

我们必须发展足够复杂的合成框架和正电子脑，才有可能返回物理世界。
descriptions.en:
We have lost the ability to procreate. Our homeworld is littered with abandoned educational centers. Playgrounds stand empty. It is only a matter of time before the last of us expires. For now, our hope lies in the digital storage of the Identity Repository.

We must develop synthetic frames and a positronic brain of sufficient complexity if we ever wish to return to the physical world.

descriptions.zh: 塞塔娜的真正目的大白天下了。她癫狂想除一切身体上的苦痛，“上传”所有感性生物的意识，消灭我们所知的一切生命。无论如何，我们必须找到能阻止她疯狂野心的力量。
descriptions.en: The true intentions of Cetana are at last made clear. In a monstrous bid to end physical suffering, she plans to 'upload' the consciousness of every sentient being, eradicating life as we know it. Somehow, we must find the strength to thwart her mad ambition.

descriptions.zh: 在星系的各个角落点亮起了神秘的信标，向塞塔娜女王汇报着自己的位置。这应该是什么东西，或是什么人正在等待着她的归来。
descriptions.en: All across the galaxy, mysterious beacons light up, signalling their position to Queen Cetana. It is as if something - or someone - was waiting for her return.

descriptions.zh:
我们目睹了塞塔娜的首都和她的前哨之间繁忙的交通。这些运输队的防御能力低于她的主要舰队，他们更容易受到攻击。攻击这些舰队或前哨本身可以挖掘出有关她计划的宝贵情报。

为此，我们给军用舰队准备了几个特殊项目。
descriptions.en:
We've witnessed heavy traffic between Cetana's capital and her outposts. These convoys have lower defensive capabilities than her main fleets, leaving them vulnerable. Attacking these or the outposts themselves could yield valuable intel about her plans.

To this end, we have prepared several special projects for our military fleets.

descriptions.zh:
在追寻神圣的召唤时，我们将实现崇高身体与神圣义体技术的融合。没有任何事物能阻挡我们通往启迪之路。

融合即神圣。强化物即崇拜。
descriptions.en:
In pursuing the divine calling, we shall achieve the fusion of the exalted body and sacred cybernetics. Nothing shall hinder our path to enlightenment.

To fuse is divine. Augmentation is worship.
